title: Attention Residuals (AttnRes / Block AttnRes)
observation: Fixed unit-weight residual accumulation causes uncontrolled hidden-state growth and dilutes each layer's contribution
architecture_intervention: Replace fixed residual sum with softmax attention over preceding layer outputs; Block AttnRes partitions layers into blocks
flop_or_gpu_hour_matched_eval: Partial - memory/communication overhead motivates Block variant; no quality-per-GPU-hour curve
routing_mechanism_analysis: Partial - output magnitude and gradient distribution across depth
overlaps_with_us: Defines the method family and the Block variant we adopt as D1's backbone
exact_non_overlap_remaining: No language-adaptation setting; no CPT from an existing checkpoint; no retention measurement; no compute-normalised quality curve

title: Delta Attention Residuals
observation: Cumulative hidden states are redundant so routing collapses to near-uniform (max weight ~0.2) in deep layers
architecture_intervention: Route over per-sublayer or per-block deltas instead of cumulative states; learned zero-init query vector w_l; additive output h + sum(alpha_i v_i)
pretrained_conversion: Yes - explicitly enables converting pretrained checkpoints via standard fine-tuning
flop_or_gpu_hour_matched_eval: No GPU-hour or wall-clock matched analysis reported in abstract
routing_mechanism_analysis: Yes - routing contrast / collapse diagnostics (max weight)
overlaps_with_us: Directly supplies our D1 condition, the conversion recipe, and the collapse diagnostic
exact_non_overlap_remaining: Conversion is demonstrated as generic fine-tuning not as language adaptation; no target-language acquisition curve; no source-language retention; no compute-normalised comparison

title: Multi-Head Attention Residuals (MHAR)
observation: A single routing query shared across the full width forces all feature subspaces to read depth history through one distribution
architecture_intervention: Reshape routing query into H per-subspace heads each with its own softmax over depth history; zero added parameters
pretrained_conversion: Yes - 8B mid-training applied on top of Delta AttnRes
flop_or_gpu_hour_matched_eval: Partial - reports fused Triton kernels raising AttnRes throughput from 0.2-0.5x to 0.55-0.88x of baseline; no quality-per-GPU-hour Pareto
routing_mechanism_analysis: Partial - U-shaped validation loss vs head count (optimum H=4 or H=8)
overlaps_with_us: Supplies our D2 condition, the H=4/H=8 candidate set, and the throughput-overhead range we must overcome
exact_non_overlap_remaining: No language adaptation; no retention; throughput reported as a ratio not as a matched quality-vs-GPU-hour frontier

title: Low-Rank Attention Residuals (LR-AttnRes)
observation: Using each layer output as both full-dimensional key and value couples routing with representation and scales scores with width d
architecture_intervention: Keep full-dimensional values but use r-dimensional routing keys (Projected and Sliced variants)
flop_or_gpu_hour_matched_eval: Partial - explicitly frames a validation-vs-FLOPs tradeoff and reduces residual-side FLOPs
routing_mechanism_analysis: Partial - shows routing needs far fewer dimensions than model width
overlaps_with_us: Occupies the compute-efficiency axis of AttnRes design
exact_non_overlap_remaining: Efficiency axis is FLOPs of the router itself not end-to-end GPU-hours of a language-adaptation run; no Thai; no retention

title: HAARES: Half-Split Residual Basis Routing (v1 title: WAV: Multi-Resolution Block Residual Routing)
observation: A cumulative block summary compresses an ordered sequence of updates into one vector and loses intra-block trajectory
architecture_intervention: Add an RMS-matched half-split detail basis alongside the cumulative block source
overlaps_with_us: Alternative block-source design competing with our D1 source definition
exact_non_overlap_remaining: No pretrained conversion; no non-English; no retention; no compute matching

title: Dual Attention Residuals (DAR)
observation: Historical retrieval and multi-stream residuals have been studied in isolation; per-stream retrievers cannot let one trajectory influence another's depth selection
architecture_intervention: Reciprocal cross-stream addressing - depth weights from the opposite stream applied to the target stream's own history; block-form variant
overlaps_with_us: Covers the 0.1B-1B dense band we target, and combines AttnRes with multi-stream residuals
exact_non_overlap_remaining: No conversion of an existing checkpoint; no language adaptation; no retention; no compute matching

title: Role-Decoupled Attention Residuals (RD-AttnRes)
observation: Queries/keys and values are forced to share one depth mixture although they play different roles
architecture_intervention: Share one depth route between queries and keys; learn an independent value route (one width vector per layer)
token_matched_eval: Yes (2.0B tokens; five matched seeds per scale)
overlaps_with_us: Most recent AttnRes design variant; sets the current bar for seed-matched rigour (5 seeds)
exact_non_overlap_remaining: No conversion; no non-English; no retention; no compute matching; small scale only

title: When Does Routing Become Interpretable? Causal Probes on Block Attention Residuals
observation: Architectural exposure of routing is necessary but not sufficient for mechanistic interpretation; routing mass dissociates from causal importance
architecture_intervention: No new architecture - causal routing-ablation interventions on two matched checkpoints
pretrained_conversion: Compares vanilla Qwen3 wrapped with a deterministic recency schedule vs Block AttnRes trained with routing
routing_mechanism_analysis: Yes - this is the paper's whole contribution: routing ablation, causal importance vs routing mass
overlaps_with_us: SEVERE: pre-empts our mechanism-analysis contribution AND uses Qwen3-0.6B, our exact pilot model
exact_non_overlap_remaining: Does not study language-conditioned routing (Thai vs English vs code-switch); no CPT; no acquisition/retention outcome linked to routing

overlaps_with_us: Occupies part of the routing-diagnostics space we planned (entropy / max-weight)

title: DenseFormer
observation: Information flow across depth is limited by the single residual stream
architecture_intervention: Depth-weighted averaging (DWA) - learned scalar weights over all previous layer outputs
flop_or_gpu_hour_matched_eval: Partial - reports inference/memory cost of DWA
overlaps_with_us: Prior art for learned depth aggregation; a reviewer will ask why we do not include it as a condition
exact_non_overlap_remaining: Static (input-independent) weights vs our input-dependent routing; no CPT; no non-English; no retention

title: DeepCrossAttention (DCA)
observation: Residual connections mix layer outputs with fixed weights and cannot select which depths to read
architecture_intervention: Learned input-dependent combination of previous layer outputs feeding attention Q/K/V
overlaps_with_us: Closest pre-2026 ancestor of input-dependent depth routing
exact_non_overlap_remaining: Predates the AttnRes family; no CPT; no non-English; no retention; no compute-matched frontier

title: Hyper-Connections
observation: Residual connections trade off gradient vanishing against representation collapse
architecture_intervention: n parallel residual streams with learned mixing matrices
overlaps_with_us: Alternative residual-topology family a reviewer will cite as an uncovered baseline
exact_non_overlap_remaining: Width-wise multi-stream not depth-wise routing; no CPT; no non-English; no retention

title: mHC: Manifold-Constrained Hyper-Connections
observation: Hyper-connection stream mixing is unconstrained and can collapse
architecture_intervention: Constrain mixing matrices to the Birkhoff polytope via Sinkhorn-Knopp
overlaps_with_us: Spawned a very large 2026 follow-up literature (xHC, Frac-Connections, mHC-lite, TBP-mHC, JPmHC and many more)
exact_non_overlap_remaining: Different residual family; no language adaptation; no retention; the whole sub-field is compute-rich from-scratch work
